coefficients.name: Lambda
coefficients.prior_or_range: taken from the declared baseline likelihood or varied under a preregistered cosmology prior
coefficients.observable: CMB, BAO, supernova, and structure observables
coefficients.rejection_rule: model comparison and posterior predictive failure under declared datasets

coefficients.name: Z_phi
coefficients.prior_or_range: strictly positive in the modeled field range
coefficients.rejection_rule: reject ghost, singular, or gradient-unstable regions

coefficients.name: m_phi
coefficients.prior_or_range: log prior bounded by the declared EFT and phenomenology domain
coefficients.null_condition: field decouples, freezes, or its constant energy is absorbed into Lambda
coefficients.observable: force range, background expansion, perturbations, and stellar behavior
coefficients.rejection_rule: exclude using existing fifth-force, cosmological, or stability bounds

coefficients.name: beta_phi
coefficients.prior_or_range: finite preregistered interval centered on zero; no inherited 1e-20 claim
coefficients.rejection_rule: exclude values inconsistent with MICROSCOPE, short-range gravity, PPN, or other declared bounds

coefficients.name: Lambda_star
coefficients.prior_or_range: greater than every modeled energy and lower than any claimed UV completion scale unless matched
coefficients.null_condition: higher-dimensional effects decouple as Lambda_star grows
coefficients.rejection_rule: reject fits that use data at or above the cutoff or violate perturbative control

coefficients.name: c_i
coefficients.domain: Wilson coefficient of a named higher-dimensional operator
coefficients.observable: operator-specific propagation, cosmology, laboratory, or collider signature
coefficients.rejection_rule: exclude unstable, acausal in-domain, or empirically ruled-out regions

coefficients.name: alpha_AB_legacy
coefficients.units: undefined until the AB manifold, Omega_AB definition, and normalization are fixed
coefficients.prior_or_range: no numerical prior permitted before dimensional closure
coefficients.null_condition: alpha_AB_legacy*Omega_AB projects to zero in the physical null limit
coefficients.observable: none until a physical extended-space model is supplied
coefficients.rejection_rule: reject any numerical use before the manifold, action, dimensions, and projection are defined

coefficients.name: epsilon_H
coefficients.prior_or_range: set through legitimate impact assessment and stakeholder governance
coefficients.observable: documented harms, appeals, incidents, and disparate impacts
coefficients.rejection_rule: pause or prohibit deployment when the governed threshold or protected right is breached
